title: Learning Sustainable Well-Being: Compassion for Self and Others, a Computing Perspective
description: This experiential course teaches the art of practicing psychological well-being, based on Eastern and Western approaches (e.g., mindfulness, positive psychology, cognitive therapy, neuroscience, theatre and art), from a computing perspective. Each week, there is a short lecture on a given topic, combined with workshop-style exercises. (P/NP grades only.) Prerequisites: none.
